entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A powerful elven animist and planeswalker who awakens the land to fight beside her and defends the natural world.

events.summary: Nissa fights fiercely and relentlessly to defend the natural world wherever it is threatened, despite her kind, soft-spoken demeanor.
events.quote: she fights both fiercely and relentlessly to defend the natural world wherever it is threatened.
